In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a '''skirmish''' occurred near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], when [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] starfighters attacked the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Crèche (clustership)|''Crèche'']]. They forced the ''Crèche'' to flee to the world of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], which forced the Yuuzhan Vong [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Battle of Fondor|strike]] early there.
